description: Check a company or person against US sanctions (OFAC SDN and other Treasury lists), Commerce BIS Entity/Denied/Unverified lists, State Department ITAR and nonproliferation lists, and the HHS OIG healthcare exclusion list. Returns strong/possible matches with the official source of each, and which lists were checked when. Needs a key for the screening API (get_api_key with its api_id from search_apis "compliance"); $0.10 per check after free checks, or included in a monthly plan.
name: screen_entity
title: Compliance screening
